paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score, a metric for evaluating translation quality, across different levels of average lagging (AL) for four distinct methods: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", ranges from 0 to 8 and is plotted on a linear scale, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", ranges from 20 to 30 and is also on a linear scale, with tick marks at integer intervals. The "Consistency-CE" method is represented by a light purple line with circular markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 20.0 at AL=0 and rising to about 27.5 at AL=8. The "Inconsistency-CE" method is shown as a dark purple line with square markers, beginning at approximately 22.0 at AL=0 and increasing to about 29.8 at AL=8. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" method is depicted by a blue line with square markers, starting at approximately 22.0 at AL=0 and rising to about 29.5 at AL=8. The "Consistency-Bi" method is represented by a red line with star markers, beginning at approximately 24.5 at AL=0 and increasing to about 30.0 at AL=8. All lines show an overall increasing trend as AL increases, with the red line consistently achieving the highest BLEU scores and the light purple line achieving the lowest.
